tools.name: get_orimark_contact
tools.description: Get Orimark Technologies' contact details and office locations, plus the URL of the contact/enquiry page.

tools.name: list_orimark_services
tools.description: List the services and software products Orimark Technologies offers, each with its page URL. Use to answer 'what do they do' or to point a user to the right page.

tools.name: open_orimark_page
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a page on orimarktechnologies.com. Accepts a root-relative path such as '/digital-marketing/' or '/contact/'.

tools.name: search_orimark_blog
tools.description: Search the Orimark Technologies blog for articles on digital marketing, web/app development, SEO, PPC and technology topics. Returns matching post titles, URLs and excerpts.
